Tesla FSD Update
- Early rollout began October 13th.
- Models include S, 3, X, Y, Cybertruck; Beta status removed globally without official announcement.
- User reports parking hesitation due to cold weather (frost/condensation) causing sensors to misread space and refuse reverse moves despite ample lane space.
- Grok confirms this is common in cold conditions per Tesla guidance: extreme temperatures interfere with sensor/camera readings, leading to overly cautious behavior.
- Solutions suggested by Grok: wipe rear/side repeaters quickly, retry once warmed up; service visit if issues persist even on mild days.
3 notes); Autopark improved to persist through more back-and-forth moves since February.
- Winter testing footage from Europe shows FSD ready for snow, but frosty-morning reversals remain unsolved locally.
- Robotaxi avoids this via geofencing (limited launch areas) and fleet learning (edge cases patched over air), though hardware improvements like heated camera housings are also noted.
